=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: Assemble changelog fragments rebase/reset at 5118-5125; Tag version and update stable pointer captures TESTED_SHA from HEAD at 5161-5170 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The stale-tip guard captures TESTED_SHA after changelog assembly, whose rebase/reset path can move HEAD to a newer untested branch tip, causing the guard to pass vacuously.
  WHY: A gate that tested commit A can tag commit B after the changelog step absorbs a concurrent branch update, releasing code that the gate never validated.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml: lines 649-657 (git push origin "refs/tags/$VERSION" then git push -f origin refs/tags/stable at line 653); the workflow has no concurrency block and no stale-tip guard anywhere | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: mark-stable.yml remains an unlocked writer of refs/tags/stable without a stale-tip guard.
  WHY: A manual dispatch can race with automated release gates and whichever writer lands last can move the consumer-pinned stable tag backwards; severity was reported as BLOCKER and MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh: 139-149 (active_count and promote_active_count jq filters) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The active-run suppression counts scheduled cycle jobs and main-branch gate_only smoke runs as active stable releases without filtering by event or branch.
  WHY: During long-running promote cycles or main smoke gates, every auto-release tick exits as release_in_flight and delays legitimate stable-branch hotfix releases.
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: 160-175 (doc_dispatched_before function) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: doc_dispatched_before trusts any tracking-issue comment containing apply-analysis-source-doc: <path> without authenticating the commenter.
  WHY: A public commenter can forge the marker, causing pending documents to be skipped and the dispatcher or daily cycle to remain stalled until the comment is removed.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh: lines 203-212, last_cycle_baseline_sha() | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: last_cycle_baseline_sha trusts the last tracking-issue comment containing apply-analysis-cycle-baseline-sha: without checking author or author_association.
  WHY: A public commenter can forge the current main SHA, making the cycle conclude that no code changed and skip daily promotion indefinitely.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 10531-10534 (untrusted_marker computed as "any untrusted marker exists") and line 10971 (untrusted elif ordered before the verifying elif at line 10991) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The callback handles any untrusted marker before a trusted verifying marker, even when both exist.
  WHY: An extra forged comment can prevent completion handling and removal of ai:comprehensive-test-pending, wedging subsequent daily promotions until a human removes the label.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: TESTED_SHA capture at line ~5161; preceding "Assemble changelog fragments" failure path at line ~5125 (git reset --hard "origin/${SOURCE_BRANCH}") | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog failure-path reset makes TESTED_SHA match BRANCH_TIP, so the stale-tip guard passes after absorbing an untested branch update.
  WHY: A gate testing commit A can reset to commit B and tag B even though only A was smoke-tested.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml: release job starting at line 549; tag-push step git push -f origin refs/tags/stable at line ~653 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: mark-stable.yml writes refs/tags/stable without the stable-release concurrency group or stale-tip check.
  WHY: A manual release can race an automated gate and leave consumers on an older unvalidated revision.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh: active-run suppression at lines ~122-150 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: active_count includes scheduled cycle jobs, gate_only smoke runs, and other runs that cannot produce a stable release.
  WHY: Active promote-cycle or main smoke runs cause auto-release ticks to skip legitimate stable hotfixes.
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh: 159-174 (doc_dispatched_before function) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The dispatch-history query accepts any comment marker without an author or author_association filter.
  WHY: A public commenter can forge a marker and permanently suppress a document, reducing candidates below PROMOTE_CYCLE_MIN_DOCS.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh: 198-216 (last_cycle_baseline_sha function) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The baseline lookup accepts any tracking-issue comment without authenticating the comment author.
  WHY: A forged current-main SHA makes the daily cycle skip with no_code_changes_since_last_cycle.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  WHY: A forged source-doc marker makes unprocessed_docs skip the document and can reduce candidates below PROMOTE_CYCLE_MIN_DOCS.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 10531-10534 (untrusted_marker computed as "any untrusted marker exists") and line 10971 (untrusted elif ordered before the verifying elif at line 10991) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any untrusted marker takes precedence over a trusted verifying marker.
  WHY: A forged comment can keep ai:comprehensive-test-pending after completion and wedge daily promotions.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh: lines 139-148 (active_count and promote_active_count jq filters) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Active-run suppression counts all test-and-mark-stable.yml and promote-main-to-stable.yml runs without event or branch filtering.
  WHY: Scheduled and main gate_only runs block auto-release ticks even though they cannot tag stable.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: line 5119 (git rebase "origin/${SOURCE_BRANCH}" on push retry), line 5125 (git reset --hard "origin/${SOURCE_BRANCH}" after exhausted pushes), feeding TESTED_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" at line 5161 and the guard comparison at line 5167 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog step can rebase or reset HEAD to a newer branch tip before TESTED_SHA is captured.
  WHY: The stale-tip guard can pass for a tree that the gate's test jobs never saw.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml: lines 649-657 (git push origin "refs/tags/$VERSION" then git push -f origin refs/tags/stable at line 653); the workflow has no concurrency block and no stale-tip guard anywhere | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: mark-stable.yml is an unlocked third writer of refs/tags/stable.
  WHY: A manual run can interleave version and stable-tag pushes with automated gates and move the consumer-pinned tag backwards.
